Our Hero Product

Parabraksh.

Solar-powered smart animal deterrent — conceptualized, iterated, designed and manufactured completely in India.

Enquire Now Download Brochure →
01 ☀️

Solar Charged by Day

Integrated solar panel harvests daylight into environment-friendly Lithium Chemistry batteries. Dual solar + micro-USB backup ensures the battery is always optimally charged — even in dense canopy or monsoon overcast. Zero running costs. Perpetual readiness.

02 🌙

Auto-Activates at Dusk

Automatically switches on at nightfall, off at dawn. No manual operation ever needed. It guards when animals are most active — every single night.

1 Year Service Warranty
💡

360° White Starburst Flash

Four powerful LEDs fire an irregular, randomised pattern of brilliant white light across a full 360°. The starburst — visible up to 250m — exploits hardwired predator aversion to sudden illumination in darkness. Predators cannot adapt to the randomised rhythm.

Our Story

Engineering with purpose.

Katidhan was founded on a simple belief: that technology can resolve conflict without cruelty. Every year, thousands of farmers across India lose their crops, livestock — and sometimes their livelihoods — to wildlife. Meanwhile, animals are killed in retaliation. We decided there had to be a better way.

We are a Bengaluru-based deep-tech startup, recognized by Startup India and Startup Karnataka, winners of the Government of Karnataka's Elevate 2019 grant, and proud alumni of Shark Tank India Season 3.

Our flagship product, Parabraksh, is a solar-powered smart animal deterrent light — completely conceptualized, designed, and manufactured in India. It has now been deployed across 12 Indian states, protecting over 1,600 farming families with zero animal attacks reported.

We believe in coexistence. Parabraksh doesn't hurt animals — it simply teaches them that some boundaries are not worth crossing.
